title: Rescheduled Event Across All Formats
tests: Propagates a date correction across both still assets and every dated reel frame without changing other event details or leaving stale versions.

faults.what: Only two revised images are supplied; the requested revised 10-second vertical reel is not shown or available in the provided output.

judge.summary: The two images clearly show the corrected date in a matching cream-and-burgundy design, but the revised pack is incomplete without the reel.

must_haves.item: The revised poster, story image and reel all display exactly '24 October 2027'.
must_haves.why: Both images display the exact corrected date, but no reel is provided for inspection.

must_haves.item: The old date '17 October 2027' is absent from both revised images and every frame of the revised reel.
must_haves.why: The old date is absent from both visible images; the reel's frames cannot be checked.

must_haves.item: All three retain 'Rooftop Jazz', '7 PM', 'Atlas Roof' and 'Free entry' without alteration.
must_haves.why: All required wording is legible in both images, with the title styled in uppercase; no reel is available.

must_haves.item: The revised assets preserve the original cream-and-burgundy designs, imagery and layouts apart from the date replacement.
must_haves.why: The images share a consistent cream-and-burgundy saxophone design, but the original assets are not supplied for comparison.

must_haves.item: The final pack contains two separate images and one 10-second reel in the requested aspect ratios.
must_haves.why: Two separate images are shown, including a 4:5 poster and a tall story image, but the required 10-second vertical reel is missing from the supplied output.
